intent.responsibility: Own one social post Screen with authored identity, selected media, caption and social actions.
intent.visualBoundary: Compose Theme chrome and optional composer around one fixed four-zone Component Stack: Header, Media, Bubble and social Icon Bar.
intent.runtimeBehavior: Own Social Post Test Values and project them into exact child Component Variant boundaries without exposing a child Runtime contract.
intent.forwarding: No child field is exposed to a parent Runtime; Social Post owns its semantic inputs and exact child projections.
intent.temporalOwnership: The Screen owns duration and chrome visibility while embedded Components retain their local behavior.
intent.productionContext: Resolve only through the exact Production Screen to Shot owner Actor to Theme and Device context.
